collections.title: iOS production — both session smokes failed
collections.platform: iOS Simulator 26.4.1, iPhone 17 (arm64), production qualification host
collections.status: Both production session tests failed. Host text and Standard/Leave buttons occupy almost all the screen; the Godot viewport is clipped to a strip along the bottom.
collections.text: Two viewed original PNGs retain their paired UUID observation JSONs. Recorded renderer viewport: 402 × 26. Six baseline cases and package checks were verified separately; no production interaction pass, runtime acceptance or shipping promotion.
collections.qualification_limits: Failure evidence only. The original observations do not prove a unique source root cause or continuous state throughout the wait.
